name: windows-clear-temp-files
description: Deletes temporary files older than N days from the Windows temp folder and/or every user's %TEMP%. Files in use are skipped. Use dry_run to only list what would be removed.

parameters.name: older_than_days
parameters.description: Only delete files last modified more than this many days ago.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: system = C:\Windows\Temp, users = each profile's AppData\Local\Temp, all = both.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Only report what would be deleted.
